blocks.text: 暗頭仔　擱清醒　想起夢中彼個伊
blocks.spelling: àm-thâu-á koh tshing-tshénn siūnn-khí bāng-tiong hit-ê i

blocks.text: 雞在叫　天未光　點到一支無奈的煙
blocks.spelling: ke tē kiò thinn buē kng tiám-tio̍h tsi̍t ki bô-nāi ê hun

blocks.text: 漂泊啊　不了時　想起當初彼個伊
blocks.spelling: phiau-pi̍k ah bô-liáu-sî siūnn-khí tong-tshoo hit-ê i

blocks.text: 眼框紅　心頭酸　又擱點到一支無奈的煙
blocks.spelling: ba̍k-khoo âng sim-thâu sng iū koh tiám-tio̍h tsi̍t ki bô-nāi ê hun

blocks.text: 賭強的個性　衝動的心
blocks.spelling: tóo-kiông ê kò-sìng tshóng-pōng ê sim

blocks.text: 懂歹誌之後才來哭不出聲
blocks.spelling: bat pháinn tsì liáu-āu tsiah lâi khàu buē tshut-siann
